title: Spooky Skull Raku
source_quote:
Spooky Skull Raku

Making session: Friday September 25th 6-8pm

Raku session: Friday October 9th 6-9pm

$125 per person, members receive a 15% discount with code RAKU15OFF

Ages 16 and up
evidence_sentence: Participants make fist-sized skulls on September 25, glaze them, and raku fire them on October 9 by pulling from the fire into combustibles.
evidence_quote: You'll glaze and raku fire your skulls to a gleaming red hot and then pull them from the fire and place them among combustibles.
summary: Two-session raku workshop: make and bisque skulls (Sept 25), then glaze and raku fire them by hand-pulling from the kiln into combustibles (Oct 9). $125 per person.
cost_text: $125 per person, members receive a 15% discount
commitment: Fri Sept 25, 6-8pm making session · Fri Oct 9, 6-9pm raku session
